doubts.claim_under_doubt: The initial and delivery-refresh F11 paths share the same marker-guard semantics.
doubts.disproof_attempt: recheck_local_gates catches UnicodeError and returns true, while the initial F11 path can grep an undecodable marked script and execute it. A marked script with invalid UTF-8 bytes could therefore be skipped and pushed only by delivery refresh.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Inspect the marker as bytes so unmarked undecodable consumers no-op but marked ones execute and fail closed.
